Turf & Artificial Grass in the Blue Mountains

New turf or premium artificial grass — a green, usable lawn that copes with Mountains shade, frost and traffic.

A good lawn up here comes down to prep and the right choice. We lay quality turf on properly graded and prepared soil, or install premium artificial grass where shade, slope or wear make real turf hard to keep.

Either way you get a clean, even, hard-wearing lawn without the guesswork.

What’s included

  • Supply and lay quality turf
  • Soil prep, grading and levelling
  • Premium artificial grass installs
  • Great for shaded and high-wear areas
  • Clean edges and finishing
  • Low-maintenance options
